_about: Where this app keeps its data in YOUR Cloudflare account. These are identifiers, not passwords, so they are safe to keep in GitHub. The deploy (scripts/deploy-cloudflare.mjs) uses exactly these and never creates a second database or bucket. A value in an environment variable of the same purpose (CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, D1_DATABASE_ID, R2_BUCKET_NAME) wins over this file.
